content.title: Happy Eid ul-Fitr 2026: Top 75+ Eid Mubarak Wishes, Messages, Quotes, Status, Greetings To Share On March 20
content.text: Eid ul-Fitr is being celebrated in the majority of Arab countries on March 20, while in India, the crescent moon sighting will be observed on Friday. Accordingly, EID is expected to be held on March 21st for India and its neighboring countries. Eid ul Fitr, which is also popularly called Eid al-Fitr or Meethi Eid, marks the end of the month-long Ramadan fasting. This festival is one of the holiest occasions for Muslims and is celebrated worldwide.That being said, here are some of the heartfelt, inspirational and best wishes, quotes, messages, greetings and status to share on March 20.According to CaratLane, here are the best wishes and messages to share on EID:Eid Mubarak 2026 Wishes:1. Wishing you and your family a healthy and happy Eid. May Allah bless you with vitality!2. On this blessed occasion, I pray for your well-being and endless blessings.3. Stay safe, stay happy, and celebrate Eid with a heart full of gratitude.4. May Allah grant you a long life filled with health, happiness, and prosperity. Eid Mubarak!5. May this Eid bring healing, happiness, and wellness into your life. Stay blessed!Powered by:Eid Mubarak 2026 Wishes For Family6. Eid Mubarak to my wonderful family!
